title: Rigidity of Euclidean Minimal Hypersurfaces under Nonuniform Diagonal Dilations
summary: Let $n\ge3$ and $D_t=\operatorname{diag}(t^{g_1},\ldots,t^{g_n})$ be a positive diagonal dilation family. We study connected embedded Euclidean hypersurfaces whose diagonal images are minimal. The level-set minimality operator splits into coefficients indexed by the pair sums $g_i+g_j$. Under pair-sum nonresonance, minimality at only $\binom n2$ distinct dilation parameters forces all pair coefficients to vanish.
